startLead: Upload your deck and the slides get ready; related materials are then found automatically.
readyLead: Your slides are ready. Connect the presentation screen and start whenever you are ready.
captureDenied: The microphone is unavailable, so speaking pace is not measured.
captureUnavailable: The microphone could not start. Please try again.
evidencePreparingQuietly: Looking for materials related to the current slide.
evidencePrepared: Showing related materials as they are found.
referenceLead: Upload related documents or a folder and related materials are found inside them. Optional.
referenceIndexed: {count} reference document(s) are ready to search.
referenceRejected: The reference material could not be uploaded. Please try again.
referenceEmptyDocument: Nothing readable could be found in the document.
referenceStoredUnindexed: Stored {total} reference document(s); {unindexed} cannot be searched yet.
evidenceFailed: Related materials could not be prepared for {count} slide(s). You can keep presenting without them.
evidenceFailedReason: You can retry, or keep presenting as is.
audiencePopupBlocked: The browser blocked the presentation screen window. Try again or copy the link and open it yourself.
audienceJoinTimeout: The presentation screen has not responded yet.
audienceBindFailed: Could not connect the presentation screen. Please try again.
audienceOpensBeside: The presentation screen opens beside this window. When sharing your screen, choose that window, not this one.
connectLead: If you opened the presentation screen on another device, paste its connection code here.
reportFinalizing: Ending the presentation and compiling its results.
reportFinalizeFailed: The presentation results could not be compiled.
reportPending: The presentation results are being compiled.
signInLead: Prepare your materials and check what you need for the talk and questions.
signInPrivacy: Signing in takes you to presentation preparation.
signInFailed: We could not sign you in. Check your username and password.
signUpLead: Once your account is created you go straight to presentation preparation.
signUpUsernameRules: Use lowercase letters, numbers, periods, underscores, or hyphens. Enter 3-32 characters, starting and ending with a lowercase letter or number.
signUpPrivacy: Creating an account takes you to presentation preparation.
signUpUsernameTaken: That username is already in use. Choose another username.
signUpUsernameInvalid: Check the username format and try again.
signUpPasswordTooShort: Use at least 8 characters for your password.
signUpFailed: We could not create your account. Try again shortly.
liveApprovalLead: Preparation and presenting happen on the same screen.
approvalNeedsDeck: Upload your presentation in the preparation screen first.
autoSuggestions: Suggestions for this presentation load automatically.
snapshotFailed: We could not load the latest suggestions. Try again.
liveApprovalFailed: Approval failed. Load the latest suggestions again.
uploadFailed: The presentation could not be uploaded. Please try again.
uploadTooLarge: The presentation file exceeds the upload size limit. Try a smaller deck.
moveControl: Move the presenter view to a separate device to continue.
coResidentLead: The presenter view and the presentation screen share this computer. Move the presenter view to another device before duplicating displays.
connectControls: Connect the presentation screen to control slides.
bindingExpired: The presentation screen connection expired. Press again to open a fresh screen and continue.
slideChanged: The presentation screen moved to the selected slide.
startedMessage: Presentation started. The presentation screen shows the first slide.
slideLoadFailed: The slide could not be loaded.
stageHandshakeWaiting: Open the presentation screen and its connection request appears here.
stagePairPending: The newly opened presentation screen is asking to connect.
qaLead: The talk has ended. Answer audience questions using your slides and uploaded materials.
qaRecordDenied: Microphone permission was denied, so spoken questions are unavailable. Please type instead.
qaRecordUnavailable: The microphone could not be started, so spoken questions are unavailable. Please type instead.
qaRecordFailed: Speech could not be transcribed. Try again or type the question instead.
qaAsking: Looking for content related to the question.
qaAbstainedRetryable: The answer could not be generated. Please try again.
qaAbstainedTerminal: Your uploaded materials do not contain what is needed to answer this question.
qaFailed: We could not process that request. Please try again.
reportQaUnavailable: The Q&A record could not be displayed.
reportQaRetryable: No answer generated · the same question can be retried
reportQaFinal: No answer · the materials cannot answer this question
preparationWhileSpeaking: Materials and screen connection while presenting
reportLead: Review your presentation time and question history.
